manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the highest point of a throw, a ball stops moving for an instant while gravity pulls it down at a constant rate.
manifest.description: Two panels show a ball tossed upward and its velocity over time. The left panel shows the height of the ball, its velocity and acceleration vectors, and the downward force of gravity. The right panel plots velocity against time, illustrating that acceleration remains constant even when velocity is zero.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
